SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AND RELEASE OF CLAIMS
EMPLOYEE hereby releases ... claims for unpaid wages, overtime wages, meal and rest period premiums, penalties ... including any claims that EMPLOYEE may bring on his/her own behalf under California's Private Attorneys General Act. ... not given on account of, or in exchange for, undisputed wages due ... waives California Civil Code section 1542 ... Harbor Grill will pay EMPLOYEE by check the gross amount without withholdings ... will issue an IRS Form 1099 ... considers this to be payment of a penalty, and therefore, no taxes are due. The lawyer for plaintiffs is Jane Doe of Doe Law and can be reached at (818) 293-5623. IF YOU NEED THIS AGREEMENT TRANSLATED INTO SPANISH ... PLEASE INFORM HARBOR GRILL.
